topLevelAdditions.phase04bRevisionNote: Local Phase04B candidate (FDA-003): the account-deletion client accepts deployed delete-account v4 status=deleted as a confirmed synchronous deletion (marks its receipt terminal, signs out, clears the receipt, announces success once). Every other reply is a typed unconfirmed outcome that never signs out and is never re-sent automatically. account-deletion-status is gated before the network by accountDeletionAsyncStatusAvailable() (false). This manifest does not mark any async deletion route deployed.

callSites.name: delete-account
callSites.note: Phase04B: only a validated {status:'deleted'} is a confirmed success. Network loss, explicit v4/server error, relay error, 401/403, malformed or unknown bodies, and status=requested without the Phase05 capability are typed AccountDeletionUnconfirmedError reasons: no success, no sign-out, no automatic resend. Concurrent calls share one in-flight request; a server-confirmed (terminal) receipt short-circuits any later attempt to local cleanup.
